title: G By The Sea
meta_description: Spacious 3-bedroom seaside cottage with a private heated pool, short walk from the beach. Includes bikes and exclusive beach bonfires for the perfect coastal escape.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Welcome to G By The Sea, your ultimate beach retreat just moments away from pristine sugar-white sands. This recently renovated seaside cottage invites you into a tropical paradise, complete with a private backyard oasis featuring a sparkling heated pool. With three bedrooms and three bathrooms, G By The Sea provides a spacious and stylish escape for your coastal getaway. Step into the fully equipped kitchen, where you can craft delicious meals and snacks to energize your beach adventures, then unwind in your private backyard oasis with a refreshing dip in the heated pool, perfect for soothing tired muscles and creating cherished memories with loved ones. For even more fun and convenience, enjoy two beach cruiser bikes available in the garage for easy rides to the shoreline, morning coffee runs, or sunset cruises, which makes transporting your crew to and from the sand effortless and enjoyable. Whether grilling your day's catch, relishing a tranquil evening under the stars, or biking along scenic streets, G By The Sea serves as your gateway to the perfect beach getaway.

ABOUT THE AREA: G By The Sea is close to everything that you could want in a beach vacation. You're just a short 7-minute walk from the sugar-sand beaches of the Emerald Coast. A quick drive west takes you to Camp Helen State Park on Lake Powell, where you can rent kayaks or YOLO boards, while a short drive east brings you to family-friendly attractions like swimming with dolphins at the aquarium or riding the Sky Wheel at Pier Park. Finally just beyond Camp Helen you can explore the charm of our 10+ beach villages along 30A and their endless options for dining, shopping and live music! But if you just want to relax, then there's plenty of that too.

BEACH ACCESS: 7-minute walk

ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 12
- Bedroom 1 - King, ensuite
- Bedroom 2 King, hallway full bath
- Bedroom 3 Bunk Room 2 Full/Queen, hallway bath
- Living Room sleeper sofa

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
- Private Heated Pool with large backyard (heated upon request)
- 2 Beach Cruiser Bikes
- Firepit
- Gas Grill Propane
- Smart TVs in every bedroom
- Washer/Dryer
- Coffee Maker - Keurig Duo
- Full linen package: bedding bath towels, wash clothes
- Fully stocked kitchen

Exclusive invitation to seasonal BEACH BONFIRES! Please reach out for more information!

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Please observe and adhere to all home rules.
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Guests must be 25 years or older to book this home.
- Pool can be heated for an additional fee of $150/night plus tax and must be paid for the whole duration of your stay.

Parking Details:
- This home includes parking for up to 2 cars.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
